entities.summary: Major General Alexander McDougall was a Continental Army officer and politician who was a leader of Sons of Liberty during the American Revolution. He served in the Army during the Revolutionary War, and as a delegate to the Continental Congress. After the war, he was the president of the first bank in the state of New York and served a term in the New York State Senate.
